title: The coastal gallop
alt: A dark horse gallops across a wet beach, with a reflection beneath its four legs.
description: Animal motion, wet-sand reflections and warm coastal light.
prompt: A dramatic side-on wildlife photograph of one dark brown horse galloping alone across a wet beach at sunrise. The entire animal is visible with exactly four distinct anatomically connected legs in a believable galloping phase, a flowing mane and one tail. Hooves throw small arcs of water, a continuous reflection appears in wet sand below, distant cliffs and low surf create depth. Natural equine anatomy, cinematic copper and slate colours, no rider, no text.
